question: The concentration of which plant hormone is highest at the top of the plant and decreases as you get closer to the roots?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Auxin**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Auxins are plant growth hormones that help in** promoting cell elongation,** which is essential for **plant growth**.
 
• Aid in fruit set and maturation, can induce fruit development without fertilization.
 
• The most commonly referenced auxin is** indole-3-acetic acid (IAA**), which is the primary natural auxin in plants.
 
• Its chemical formula is **C₁₁H₉N₃O₂.**
 
• Auxins are involved in the development of fruits, influencing processes such as fruit set, **growth, and maturation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cytokinin**
 
• Cytokinins are used to promote cell division and shoot development, making them valuable in agricultural practices to enhance crop yields.
 
 
• They stimulate the growth of lateral buds and enhance shoot development, counteracting apical dominance exerted by auxins.
 
• They are used to extend the shelf life of cut flowers and fruits by delaying leaf and flower senescence, thus maintaining their freshness for longer periods.
 
• The most common naturally occurring cytokinin is zeatin, it's chemical formula** C₁₁H₁₃N₅O.**
 
 
 
 
• **Gibberellin**
 
 
• Gibberellins promote **seed germination** by breaking dormancy, enhancing the growth of seedlings.
 
• Gibberellins can be applied to promote fruit set, improve fruit size, and prevent premature fruit drop, particularly in grapes and apples.
 
• Gibberellins are often used in agriculture to enhance overall crop yields, increase size and quality of fruits, and improve harvest efficiency.
 
• he most well-known gibberellin is **gibberellic acid (GA3),** which has the following chemical formula:** C₁₉H₂₂O₆.**
 
 
 
• **Ethylene**
 
 
• Ethylene is widely used to promote the ripening of fruits. It accelerates the ripening process in climacteric fruits like bananas, tomatoes, and apples.
 
• Ethylene regulates the shedding of leaves,** flowers, and fruits (abscission**), playing a role in plant development and life cycle management.
 
• Ethylene is also used in the production of various chemicals and plastics, such as polyethylene, which is a widely used polymer.
 
• The chemical formula of ethylene is** C₂H₄.**
